name: chevalet-note
description: Sticky notes stuck to the page, not the browser. Firefox extension.

scripts.dev: pnpm build:dev && web-ext run --source-dir dist --target firefox-desktop
scripts.package: pnpm build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm lint:ext
